messages:
Maria (Marketing): Drafting a concise 1‑pager + launch grid for regulated enterprise customers — needs to cover security, SLAs, and deployment modes. Also want a short webinar narrative and inbound lead routing. Quick sync?
Kevin (Solutions): I can do a deploy-mode matrix: Hosted / Dedicated / Private with the security controls and typical latency/cost bullets.
Alex (Product): Add a tight line about private control plane + KMS/HSM + audit logs. Also call out automated fallback routing for degraded capacity (important for SLAs).
Jess (Sales): We need a procurement-friendly blurb: SLA terms, onboarding timeline, and expected lead response flow (self-serve -> solutions engineer -> AE). One sentence each max.
Sam (Analytics): I’ll pull a compact benchmark snapshot (p50/p95/p99 + cost multiplier for quantized builds). Will aim to have numbers by EOD.
Maria (Marketing): For the webinar narrative: 1) Problem for regulated apps, 2) Redwood deployment options + controls, 3) Benchmarks + short customer vignette, 4) CTA (trial or dedicated demo). One slide per bullet.
Kevin (Solutions): For messaging, recommend three persona hooks: Platform Eng (performance & ops), Security/Compliance (controls & auditability), Procurement (SLA & TCO). Each gets a 10‑word pain->benefit line.
Jess (Sales): Inbound routing proposal: leads with "enterprise" or "security" keywords -> field-sales queue; technical/proof requests -> solutions-engineering; quick evals -> devex. Tagging rules in Salesforce.
Alex (Product): Draft line for the 1‑pager (<=30 words): "SLA-backed Dedicated pools, Private deployments with VPC & KMS, and audit trails — predictable latency and strong isolation for regulated workloads."
Sam (Analytics): Bench draft (will refine):
```
Hosted API:    p50 60ms  p95 180ms p99 300ms  (baseline cost)
Dedicated (A100): p50 25ms  p95 60ms  p99 120ms  (~x1.8 perf)
Private (quantized T4): p50 40ms  p95 90ms  p99 200ms  (~x0.6 cost)
```
Maria (Marketing): Nice — I’ll build two variants: Executive one‑pager (single column, quick bullets) + Technical appendix (one slide with the matrix + bench). Need reviewers by 4pm today.
Kevin (Solutions): I’ll review security and deployment copy by 3:30pm.
Jess (Sales): I’ll add procurement timeline and routing notes by 3pm.
ops-bot: Reminder: webinar slot confirmed 2026-05-12 10:00 PT. Speakers: Maria, Kevin, Alex. Recording enabled.
Maria (Marketing): Thanks all — I’ll post the draft link in #marketing in ~45m :rocket:
